content:
Here is the translation to English:

Then again the lord of men Agamemnon addressed him:
'I rejoice, Laertes' son, to hear your speech,
for you have gone through all in due order and recounted.
These things I am willing to swear, and my heart bids me,
and I will not break the oath by a god. But let Achilles
remain here for the present, eager though he be for war.
And do you all remain gathered together, until the gifts
come from my shelter and we make the trusty oaths.
And this I command and charge you yourself:
Choose the best of the Panachaean youths
to bring the gifts from my ship, whatever we promised
yesterday to give to Achilles, and to lead the women.
And let Talthybius quickly get ready for me throughout
the wide army of the Achaeans a boar to be sacrificed to Zeus and the Sun.'
